| description = Faydedar is a water dragon that roams widely in [[Timorous Deep]]. A [[Faydedar_(triggered)]] version of this mob also exists, which only drops the [[Pod of Seawater]] (and occasionally a minor spell research item).  The triggered version will despawn after 20 minutes. If you try to spawn a triggered Fay with the real Fay alive, the quest mob will despawn, your item will be returned, but no Faydedar will spawn.  

See [[Faydedar (Raid)]] for popular raid tactics to use against Faydedar.
